verdict.rationale: Hightouch supports syncing audiences to ad platforms/engagement tools on a schedule or trigger with CDC to only send new/changed/removed rows, which supports near-real-time membership changes, but syncs are still schedule/trigger-based batch jobs rather than a documented continuous streaming/real-time audience membership pipeline. missing for 10: explicit documentation of true real-time/streaming sync latency (e.g. sub-minute or event-triggered entry/exit), independent evidence of sync frequency/latency in production, and confirmation that ad platform destinations support such near-real-time updates rather than periodic batch syncs.
